reason: Three Stage-A methods, including a nonlinear separability oracle and direct physical-hypothesis comparison, fail the thermal archetype on new development/calibration splits. Stage B is not justified.

requested_authority.scope: A new development/calibration-only observability study; not Stage B and not a production candidate.
requested_authority.allowed_intervention: Pre-freeze a deployable active thermal excitation and observation horizon using the existing heat.exchange, state.temperature and context.ambient_temperature channels; do not add truth-bearing inputs.
requested_authority.required_comparison: Run passive and active profiles with identical fault severities, noise ranges, case counts and model rules.
requested_authority.required_exit: Both archetypes must meet Stage-A classification, normal detection, known retention and OOD reachability checks before any Stage-B proposal.

not_authorized: Lower noise, increase fault severity or remove difficult configurations after observing results
Add a new sensor or change diagnosis_scope without a separate G1.1 artifact approval
Generate formal BIAS, INTERMITTENT or STUCK cases
Create or reserve a technical-validation seed
Fit or bind a production candidate
Change thresholds, denominators or class membership
